verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-006 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-006: a suspended or disabled staff account and a disabled service principal have no valid sessions or usable credentials
quotes: "issue a credential for a disabled principal",
verdicts.why: The check detects that disabling a service principal invalidates an existing credential and prevents issuing another. It does not test suspended or disabled staff accounts or whether their sessions and credentials are invalidated.

statements: INV-029: a producer import is authorized for the target project per scope_mode and grants before content validation
quotes: assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, PROJECT_ID) is True
assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, OTHER_PROJECT_ID) is False
assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, ARCHIVED_PROJECT_ID) is False
assert module.authorize_producer_scope(store, actor, PROJECT_ID) is False, (
verdicts.why: The check asserts project-scope decisions for granted-projects and all-projects service principals, including revoked grants. It does not execute a producer import or establish that authorization occurs before content validation.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: read value unchanged [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal]; read value unchanged [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: A value read from a repository is unchanged after any use case that read it.
verdicts.why: The check does not snapshot and compare a repository-read value after a use case. Checking returned fields or whether an update repository method was invoked does not detect in-place mutation of every value read.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: one instant per operation [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal]; one instant per operation [witness: verification:staff_bootstrap_client_portal].
statements:
All portal-owned event timestamps written by one operation, other than an
  audit record's `occurred_at`, are equal; an expiry it derives from a TTL is that instant plus its TTL, and source-supplied times, a service credential's supplied `expires_at` among them, keep their supplied values.
quotes: assert principal.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and principal.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert issue.credential.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and issue.credential.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert revoked.revoked_at == CLOCK_NOW and revoked.revoked_at.tzinfo is None
assert grant.created_at == CLOCK_NOW and grant.created_at.tzinfo is None
assert disabled.disabled_at == CLOCK_NOW and disabled.disabled_at.tzinfo is None
verdicts.why: The check enforces one clock capture for several operations and verifies individual portal-owned timestamps equal that captured instant. It does not assert equality among all timestamps written by an operation, TTL-derived expiry, or preservation of source-supplied times such as a supplied credential expires_at.

statements: INV-009: at most one active grant per (viewer_id, project_id) and per (service_principal_id, project_id)
quotes: "second active grant for the same project",
verdicts.why: The check detects a second active grant for the same service-principal/project pair. It does not test the corresponding uniqueness rule for viewer/project grants.
